newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Yields mixed on weekly Saudi treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields mixed on weekly Saudi treasury bills.

text.p: Yields were lower to steady at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills, bankers said on Tuesday.

The yield on 28-day bills dropped to 5.6497 percent from 5.6750 percent and the 91-day bills fell to 5.7777 percent from 5.7936 percent. The 182-day bills were steady at 5.9207 percent and the 364-day bills fell to 6.1469 percent from 6.1905.
One-month deposit rates were quoted at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one year at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.56250, 98.56055, 97.09375 and 94.14844 respectively. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
